head_review.handoff_observation: At verification start the active remote branch stopped at 242226d; the three claimed SA-1.5 commits existed only on the local branch and were reviewed as the pending Antigravity diff.

decision_basis: The real FVD materials and deterministic script parse are genuine, but the canonical product path does not derive the evidenced Greece base, shoot duration, currency, travel, or territorial facts into optimizer-ready state and does not execute the worldwide optimizer. The FVD acceptance runner constructs those economics with project-specific constants. The UI and held-out-calibration claims are also unsupported.

gates.name: real FVD budget
gates.evidence: The persisted current budget is V-BRAT_V8_Greece_041224 TOPSHEET.pdf, linked to the FVD project and byte-identified by SHA-256 253e80e987a0aa3c06110dcbc5f6c99fd20042579603a94e29039c1e0a72eaa1. Its title/body identify F#*K VALENTINES DAY and a Greece preliminary budget.

gates.name: budget reconciliation
gates.evidence: Authoritative PDF Grand Total USD 4,517,687.00 equals BudgetDocument.total_budget_raw, the sum of 34 parsed amount_raw rows, and the sum of 34 amount_usd rows exactly; variance USD 0.00.

gates.name: Greece provenance
gates.evidence: SOURCE FACT: Greece. The actual budget states PRELIMINARY BUDGET - GREECE and Location: Greece, and names Greek Estimate Cash Rebate (40%). This is authoritative FVD production evidence, not a screenplay-setting inference. Canonical-state propagation is separately failed in gates 7 and 10.

gates.name: full project-material discovery
gates.evidence: The filesystem source set and ingestion-candidate ledger reconcile: four top-level source files and three nested Underwater files were discovered. FVD screenplay, budget, and deck were committed; the unrelated MaggieMoores image remained unassociated; the nested Underwater screenplay, budget, and deck were routed to the separate Underwater project. No separate FVD schedule existed in the presented source set.

gates.name: semantic routing
gates.evidence: FVD screenplay -> screenplay, Greece top sheet -> budget, FVD deck -> deck, and extracted deck cover -> artwork. Underwater materials were not persisted under FVD.

gates.name: UI runtime
gates.evidence: Classification: API_ONLY_VERIFIED. run_sa1_5_acceptance.py uses httpx ASGITransport directly against the FastAPI app. No frontend caller for the script-analysis/state/optimizer-input routes and no browser -> frontend -> network -> backend -> persistence trace were found. The route module explicitly says backend routes only.

gates.name: canonical project state
gates.evidence: The live state correctly carries the script and USD-normalized budget but has zero ProductionAssumption rows, no source-currency field, null base jurisdiction, null shoot days, 54 unconfirmed production locations, and unknown territoriality. Despite these missing material inputs it reports READY_FOR_OPTIMIZER and the handoff returns accepted=true, base_jurisdiction=null, shoot_days=null, provisional=true. The product path stops at a data contract and does not call the worldwide optimizer.

gates.name: no generic Little Utopia contamination
gates.evidence: No executable Little Utopia, Mauritius, ALLOC-BASELINE-MU, home_code=MU, or jurisdiction_code=MU dependency exists in the inspected generic FVD state/handoff path. Remaining Little Utopia references are comments or separate regression/runtime fixtures.

gates.name: FVD runner is thin/generic
gates.evidence: Disposition: PROJECT_SPECIFIC_ORCHESTRATION (B). run_fvd_optimizer.py reads a validation fixture and directly constructs ProductionFacts, Greece doctrine/rate, discovery, baseline and alternative StructureSpecs, account allocation, travel normalization, FX normalization, pricing, and ranking. It hardcodes GR, gr_cash_rebate, ALLOC-BASELINE-GR, and travel inputs rather than invoking a generic canonical execution service.

gates.name: project facts provenance
gates.evidence: The persisted 20 ProjectFact rows and 127 ProductionRequirement rows are deterministic and version-linked to the screenplay. The actual budget evidences Greece and 18 shoot days, but neither is propagated into canonical assumptions. Runner travel values (LA origin, one business traveler, four rotations, 14 hotel nights, 14 per-diem days) have no FVD source or persisted provenance and are arbitrary runner inputs presented in the FVD economic run.

gates.name: actual-vs-modeled separation
gates.evidence: The persisted Greece budget remains the actual project baseline. Alternative allocations operate on copied input values and do not rewrite BudgetDocument or BudgetLineItem historical records. The custom runner defect does not itself mutate the actual budget.

gates.name: held-out calibration fixture
gates.evidence: SCRIPT_ANALYZER_REAL_BUDGET_FIXTURE_001.json has only parse_result, script_state, canonical_state, and optimizer_input. It has no SCRIPT_DERIVED_STATE / HELD_OUT_ACTUAL_PRODUCTION_STATE partition, and embeds the actual USD 4,517,687 budget and all 34 lines in both canonical_state and optimizer_input. It cannot serve as a script-only prediction fixture without actual-budget leakage.

gates.name: script-only architecture preserved
gates.evidence: The generic state explicitly represents BUDGET_MISSING as an honest blocker and documents that SA-1 does not estimate a budget while a later phase may supply a Level-1 estimate. The FVD actual-budget work did not encode FVD's budget as a universal Script Analyzer prerequisite or prediction feature.

gates.name: genericity probe
gates.evidence: A deterministic Canada probe passed CA, USD-normalized gross cost, and 22 shoot days through build_optimizer_input without editing source. However, the contract has no source-currency field and the canonical builder does not propagate BudgetDocument.currency_code; CAD could only be smuggled through an untyped assumption. More importantly, the generic handoff does not execute discovery/allocation/pricing/ranking, so a non-Greece project still requires orchestration equivalent to a new custom runner.

gates.name: Little Utopia regression
gates.evidence: Targeted pytest test_mauritius_baseline_regression_including_the_non_claiming_us_segment passed: rank 1 ALLOC-BASELINE-MU, Mauritius, NPC USD 3,057,794.90. The full SA-1 targeted file also passed 23/23 tests.

defects: The canonical state calls FVD optimizer-ready while base jurisdiction, shoot days, source currency, production locations, and territoriality are absent.
ProductionOptimizerInput is only a mapping contract; no generic product service consumes it to execute discovery, allocation, normalization, pricing, and ranking.
run_fvd_optimizer.py is a project-specific economic orchestrator with hardcoded Greece/program/baseline/travel values.
The evidenced Greece base and 18-day schedule are not persisted or propagated as provenance-bearing canonical facts/assumptions.
Arbitrary runner travel parameters have no FVD evidence or labeled canonical default authority.
The UI workflow claim is unsupported; only in-process API calls were exercised.
The real-budget fixture has no held-out boundary and leaks actual budget lines into the optimizer input.
The handoff contract drops source currency and therefore fails the complete genericity proof.
At verification start, the claimed SA-1.5 commits were not present on the current remote branch.
smallest_required_implementation_workloa: Persist and propagate the budget-evidenced base jurisdiction (GR), source currency (USD), and 18 shoot days with DocumentVersion-level provenance; leave unsupported values UNKNOWN.
Tighten canonical readiness so material optimizer inputs cannot be accepted as READY merely because script and budget exist.

Add one generic execution service that consumes ProductionOptimizerInput and invokes existing discovery, structure, allocation, travel/FX, pricing, and ranking calculators without project constants; reduce the FVD runner to an API/service invocation and assertions.
Replace runner travel constants with sourced/user-confirmed inputs or explicit provisional model defaults that cannot be presented as actual facts.
Add source currency as a first-class canonical/handoff value and prove a non-GR/non-MU project reaches the same generic executor without source edits.
Split the FVD calibration artifact into script-derived prediction input and a separately held-out actual-production/budget comparison payload.
Either implement and browser-verify the frontend path or remove the UI-verified claim until that work exists.
